jobs.description:

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 14 December.. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

• Positive attitude

Global leader in specialized logistics and transportation solutions. The company supports time-critical shipments across healthcare, life sciences and other highly regulated industries, ensuring products reach their destination safely, securely and on time.

jobs.occupation: German Business developer | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating in the food industry. Combining the mindset of a family business with strong entrepreneurial ambitions, they offer a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

To support their continued international growth, they are looking for a German-speaking Business Developer to further develop the German market.

This position is 100% on-site in Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As a German Business Developer, you will play an active role in expanding the company's presence in Germany. You will have the opportunity to build your own network, develop new business and create long-term customer relationships.

Your responsibilities include:

• Proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities within the German market.
• Reaching out to potential customers and opening new commercial doors.
• Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and closing deals.
• Following up on commercial opportunities and developing your customer portfolio.
• Monitoring the German market and identifying new trends and opportunities.
• Tracking sales activities and results.
• Contributing ideas and market insights to the broader commercial strategy.

We are looking for someone with commercial drive, ambition and the motivation to make things happen. Previous experience is welcome, but your mindset and potential are just as important.

• You are fluent in German and English. Knowledge of Dutch or another language is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development or another commercial role is a plus, but definitely not a must.
• Motivated junior candidates and recent graduates are very welcome to apply. If you are eager to learn, commercially minded and excited by the idea of developing a market, we would love to hear from you.
• You are proactive and enjoy approaching new prospects and creating opportunities.
• You have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are commercially minded and motivated by achieving results.
• You are a real go-getter who is not afraid to take initiative.
• You are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• An affinity with the food industry is an advantage, but not required.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
• You are happy to work 100% on-site in Antwerp.

jobs.occupation: Executive Assistant to VP - Zaventem - Medical Industry
jobs.description:
Our client is an international medical technology company dedicated to improving patient outcomes through innovative, clinically proven solutions in key areas of care. They believe that ideas can come from anywhere, and they encourage employees at every level to make a difference.

Provide full administrative support to the VP, including calendar management, prioritization of meetings, screening calls and emails, and coordinating daily tasks.

Prepare executive summaries, meeting pre-reads, and contract materials to ensure the VP is well-informed for all engagements.

Manage budgets, vendor selection, contract negotiation, and on-site logistics for off-site meetings and conferences in coordination with procurement.

Oversee business travel and visa arrangements, and ensure timely, accurate submission of expense reports.

Create polished PowerPoint presentations, respond professionally to internal and external inquiries, and maintain discretion with sensitive information.

Build and maintain strong relationships with global and external stakeholders, support strategic meetings, training, events, and team-building activities across Europe.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:
The Commercial Coordinator role within the FMCG industry focuses on supporting sales, logistics, customer service operations in the beer sector. This position requires organisational skills to manage customer interactions and ensure smooth process optimizations.

Client Details

Our client is a main beer actor in the Belgian industry.

They have a history of knowledge and expertise and are located in Flemish Brabant.

Description

As a Commercial Coordinator your responsibilities are very varied but with as a main goal to optimize all commercial, logistics and sales support processes in the company.

 

Concretely you will:

 

• You work closely with Sales Support, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure efficient commercial operations
• You support and optimize all ongoing commercial processes and give insights on how to make the collaboration between sales, sales support and logistics more efficient
• You analyze commercial figures, market tendencies, promotions to increase commercial insights
• You analyze demand planning processes, market tendencies in the sector to make sure the forecasts are more accurate
• You support sales, sales support, customer service and logistics teams in using the CRM tool well
• You guarantee a flawless and efficient OTC process
 

 

The Commercial Coordinator should have:

• Fluent Dutch, French and English
• Analytical insights
• Able to understand different businesses and how an entire Order To Cash process works
• Good communication and influencing skills

• Analyze and map end-to-end business processes across multiple departments.

• Support digital transformation projects related to e-commerce platforms and business applications.
• Ensure process governance, standardization, and adoption across the organization.

• Mandatory experience within a B2B e-commerce environment.
• Hand-on experience with Shopify or Magento is a great advantage.
• Strong understanding of business processes, system integrations, and digital workflows.
• Experience documenting business processes, functional specifications, and user journeys.
• Fluent in French and English.
